subject.title: fix(repair): cut over durable cluster intake publication

question: Should the five dependent cluster-intake PRs be reviewed and landed as one gated sequence before enabling this final workflow cutover?
rationale: The patch is intentionally coupled to four open prerequisite PRs, and only maintainers can accept the combined operational availability risk and decide the landing sequence.

options.title: Land the gated stack in order
options.body: Review and merge https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/pull/881 through https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/pull/884 first, then rebase and merge this cutover after controlled acceptance proof.

options.title: Pause the cutover
options.body: Keep the current publication path until maintainers want to schedule a full durable-intake rollout and production acceptance exercise.

recommendation.title: Land the gated stack in order
recommendation.body: Review and merge https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/pull/881 through https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/pull/884 first, then rebase and merge this cutover after controlled acceptance proof.

likelyOwner.reason: RomneyDa owns the connected implementation stack and can provide the final combined validation context.
